prompts.double:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: existing wide 5:1 rhythm game note sprite.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is an ANNOTATED EXPLANATION ONLY: the pink circles locate the two junctions to change; the diagrams below explain the desired junction topology. Never copy labels, circles or the diagram into the output.

Make a precise, SMALL structural correction at the two inside ends of the horizontal side bars, where those bars meet the slanted outer edges of the central raised plate. On the 400x80 target, these junctions are near (104,42) and (296,42). The dark lower rim is a lower plane, while the horizontal mid-level bars are higher. Right now their edges merge flatly, so the change of level makes no visual sense.
At the LEFT junction, the horizontal edge must visibly fork into TWO short diagonal edges (a sideways Y, "-<" topology): one edge rises up-right and the other continues down-right. Reveal a small triangular or tapered side face between them, showing the step in height. Mirror this at the RIGHT junction. Integrate these short edges and small flat shaded side faces into the existing geometry, not as drawn symbols. Each correction should remain compact, within roughly x90-126 / x274-310 and y26-62. Make the branch clearly legible, with a restrained light top edge and a slightly darker thin side face. This is a shallow step, not a huge 3D protrusion or deep black hole.
Keep the existing silhouette, overall 5:1 shape, panel widths, exact palette, original shading elsewhere, central chevron icons, horizontal luminous bars and bottom rim hotspots unchanged. Avoid adding glow, texture, grain, complicated bevels or extra panels. Do not darken the rest of the sprite. The correction should look calm and precise, like a small fix to the original drawing.
Output only the edited complete sprite strip in the same framing, with no added margins, labels or presentation background. Preserve its existing transparency.
This target is GOLD DOUBLE: preserve BOTH groups of three upward chevrons and BOTH small lower-rim hotspots at x=168 and x=232. Do not return to a single central hotspot.
